test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A radius of a circular park is 23 m. It has inside all around it, a 4 m wide path. Find the cost of paving the path at the rate of Rs. 500/m².

(Take {pi ={22over7}})
solution:
**Given**

Outer radius, R = 23 m

Inner radius, r = (23 - 4)m

⇒ 19 m

**Concept**

Area of circular path = Area of outer circle - area of inner circle

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cea61c8be1e5fc21217e356320a57e32e600d95f945926f53225ff1da0c7afd.png] 

**Formula used**

Area of path = π(R² - r²)

(a² - b²) = (a + b) (a - b)

**Calculation**

Area of circular path = (22/7) × (23²- 19²)

⇒ ( 22/7) × (23 + 19) × (23 - 19)

⇒ (22/7) × (42) × (4)

⇒ 22 × 6 × 4

⇒ 132 × 4

⇒ 528m²

cost of paving the path = 528 × 500

⇒ Rs. 264000

**∴ The cost of paving the path is Rs.2,64,000**
